checkitem.desc: [p2-STANDARD] Parameter: icm/server_port_nn uses HTTPS (protect information communicated via ICM Web Dispatcher)
checkitem.compliant: NAME like 'icm/server_port_%' and VALUE like '%PROT=HTTP%' and VALUE like '%PROT=HTTPS%'
checkitem.noncompliant: NAME like 'icm/server_port_%' and VALUE like '%PROT=HTTP%' and not VALUE like '%PROT=HTTPS%'

checkitem.desc: [p2-STANDARD] Parameter: icm/HTTP/admin_nn has PORT defined (allow Web Dispatcher administration only on certain port)
checkitem.noncompliant: NAME like 'icm/HTTP/admin_%' and not VALUE like '%PORT%'

checkitem.desc: [p2-STANDARD] Parameter: icm/HTTP/admin_nn has PORT qualified, and HTTPS on that PORT (via icm/server_port_nn)
checkitem.compliant: NAME like 'icm/server_port_%' and VALUE like '%PROT=HTTPS%' and SUBSTR_REGEXPR('(PORT=)(\d+)' in VALUE GROUP 2) = SUBSTR_REGEXPR('(PORT=)(\d+)' in s1.VALUE GROUP 2)
checkitem.noncompliant: NAME like 'icm/server_port_%' and not VALUE like '%PROT=HTTPS%' and SUBSTR_REGEXPR('(PORT=)(\d+)' in VALUE GROUP 2) = SUBSTR_REGEXPR('(PORT=)(\d+)' in s1.VALUE GROUP 2)
